items.title: ASML unveils EUV light source advance that could yield 50% more chips by 2030
items.title_zh: ASML 公布 EUV 光源新进展，2030 年芯片产量有望提升 50%
items.summary: ASML has unveiled an advance in EUV light source technology that, according to Reuters, could lead to 50% more chips being produced by 2030.

items.title: President Trump bans Anthropic from use in government systems
items.raw_content: Shortly after the president's ban of artificial intelligence company Anthropic, rival OpenAI announced it had done a deal with the Defense Department to provide its technology for classified networks.
items.title_zh: 特朗普总统禁止政府系统使用 Anthropic
items.summary: NPR reports that President Trump banned Anthropic from use in government systems, and that rival OpenAI announced a Defense Department deal to provide its technology for classified networks shortly afterward.

items.title: OpenAI resets spending expectations, from $1.4T to $600B
items.raw_content: OpenAI told investors it's targeting roughly $600 billion in total compute spend by 2030, trying to clarify its plans after touting a $1.4 trillion figure.
items.title_zh: OpenAI 下调支出预期：从 1.4 万亿美元降至 6000 亿美元
items.summary: OpenAI has told investors to expect about $600 billion in total compute spending by 2030, clarifying earlier plans that pointed to $1.4 trillion.

items.title: Nano Banana 2: Google's latest AI image generation model
items.raw_content: Our latest image generation model offers advanced world knowledge, production-ready specs, subject consistency and more, all at Flash speed.
items.title_zh: Nano Banana 2：谷歌最新 AI 图像生成模型
items.summary: Google describes Nano Banana 2 as its latest image generation model, offering advanced world knowledge, production-ready specs and subject consistency at Flash speed.

items.title: World-first gigabit laser link between aircraft and geostationary satellite
items.raw_content: Faster, more secure connections from space could one day make broadband on planes, ships and even remote roads as easy as turning on a light. The European Space Agency (ESA), Airbus Defence and Space, the Netherlands Organisation for Applied Scientific Research (TNO) and German payload manufacturer TESAT (as subcontractor) successfully connected an aircraft to a geostationary satellite using laser communications, bringing people closer to seamless, high‑speed connections in daily life.
items.title_zh: 全球首次：飞机与地球静止轨道卫星实现千兆激光链路
items.summary: ESA, Airbus Defence and Space, TNO and TESAT as subcontractor connected an aircraft to a geostationary satellite using laser communications in a world-first gigabit-per-second link that could one day bring high-speed broadband to planes, ships and remote roads.

items.title: ASML unveils EUV light source advance that could yield 50% more chips by 2030
items.title_zh: ASML 公布 EUV 光源新进展，2030 年芯片产量有望提升 50%
items.summary: ASML has unveiled an advance in EUV light source technology that, according to Reuters, could lead to 50% more chips being produced by 2030.

items.title_zh: 特朗普总统禁止政府系统使用 Anthropic
items.summary: NPR reports that President Trump banned Anthropic from use in government systems, and that rival OpenAI announced a Defense Department deal to provide its technology for classified networks shortly afterward.

items.summary: Google describes Nano Banana 2 as its latest image generation model, offering advanced world knowledge, production-ready specs and subject consistency at Flash speed.

items.title: A simple web we own
items.title_zh: 一个属于我们自己的简单网络
items.summary: In a blog post, R. S. Doiel argues that the web and internet are owned and controlled by large for-profit corporations and a few governments, leaving users as “tenant and product” and producing a surveillance economy.

items.title: Terence Tao, at 8 years old (1984) [pdf]
items.title_zh: 8 岁时的陶哲轩（1984）[PDF]
items.summary: A 1984 PDF document featuring Terence Tao at eight years old.

items.title: I'm helping my dog vibe code games
items.title_zh: 我帮自家小狗用 vibe coding 做游戏
items.summary: The author describes teaching their cavapoo Momo to type, routing her input to Claude Code and building the tools that let her produce playable Godot games.

items.title: AIs can't stop recommending nuclear strikes in war game simulations
items.title_zh: AI 在兵棋推演中屡屡建议发动核打击
items.summary: In simulated war games, leading AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic and Google opted to use nuclear weapons in 95 per cent of cases, New Scientist reports.

items.title: Show HN: A real-time strategy game that AI agents can play
items.title_zh: Show HN：一款 AI 智能体可玩的即时战略游戏
items.summary: LLM Skirmish is a Show HN project that pits LLMs against each other in 1v1 real-time strategy games, drawing on a version of the open-source Screeps API so that models write code executed in the game. In the author's testing, Claude Opus 4.5 was the most dominant model, though it over-focused on its in-game economy in round one.

items.title: Tech companies shouldn't be bullied into doing surveillance
items.title_zh: 科技公司不应被胁迫参与监控
items.summary: An EFF article says the Secretary of Defense gave Anthropic an ultimatum to make its technology available to the U.S. military without restrictions, and argues that the company should refuse.

items.title: ChatGPT Health fails to recognise medical emergencies – study
items.title_zh: 研究：ChatGPT Health 未能识别医疗紧急情况
items.summary: A study found that ChatGPT Health did not recommend a hospital visit in more than half of cases where one was medically necessary.

items.title: Block the “Upgrade to Tahoe” alerts
items.title_zh: 屏蔽“升级到 Tahoe”提醒
items.summary: A post explains how to block macOS Tahoe upgrade alerts and the System Settings indicator, written by someone who keeps a desktop Mac on macOS Sequoia while running Tahoe on a laptop for customer support.

items.title: Statement on the comments from Secretary of War Pete Hegseth
items.title_zh: 关于战争部长 Pete Hegseth 言论的声明
items.summary: Anthropic published a response to comments from Secretary of War Pete Hegseth, along with advice for customers.

items.title: Ghostty – Terminal Emulator
items.title_zh: Ghostty：终端模拟器
items.summary: Ghostty is a fast, feature-rich cross-platform terminal emulator that uses platform-native UI and GPU acceleration.

items.title: AI Added 'Basically Zero' to US Economic Growth Last Year, Goldman Sachs Says
items.title_zh: 高盛：去年 AI 对美国经济增长的贡献“基本为零”
items.summary: Goldman Sachs says AI added “basically zero” to US economic growth last year, with imported chips and hardware cited in the analysis of AI investment and GDP.

items.title: Danish government agency to ditch Microsoft software (2025)
items.title_zh: 丹麦政府机构将弃用微软软件（2025）
items.summary: Denmark's digital affairs ministry says it plans to switch to the open-source LibreOffice software and away from Microsoft products as part of an effort to make the government more digitally independent.

items.title: The normalization of corruption in organizations (2003) [pdf]
items.title_zh: 组织中的腐败常态化（2003）[PDF]
items.summary: A 2003 paper, shared as a PDF, examines how corruption becomes normalized within organizations.

items.title: Honor reportedly to launch first humanoid robot at MWC 2026
items.title_zh: 荣耀据报将在 MWC 2026 发布首款人形机器人
items.summary: Honor is reportedly preparing to show its first consumer-grade humanoid robot at MWC 2026 in Barcelona, which opens on March 1.

items.title: Ufotable releases latest teaser for Genshin Impact anime
items.title_zh: Ufotable 发布《原神》动画最新预告
items.summary: A new teaser for the Genshin Impact anime was included in Ufotable's 30th-anniversary promotional video.

items.title: Huawei 2025 evenue exceeds $122 billion, chairman says
items.title_zh: 华为 2025 年营收超过 1220 亿美元，董事长表示
items.summary: Huawei's sales revenue exceeded 880 billion yuan ($122 billion) in 2025, Chairman Liang Hua said on Tuesday.

items.title: Unity Explores Potential Sale of China Unit, Reports Say
items.title_zh: 报道称 Unity 探索出售中国业务
items.summary: Bloomberg reported, citing people familiar with the matter, that Unity Software is exploring options for its China business, including a potential sale.

items.title: Rising memory chip costs may prompt Chinese smartphone makers to lift prices in March
items.title_zh: 存储芯片成本上涨或促使中国手机厂商 3 月提价
items.summary: TechNode reports that soaring memory and storage chip prices are likely to push major Chinese smartphone brands to raise handset prices in early March, according to supply-side sources.

items.title: Transsion’s 2025 profit halves, market value falls over 60%
items.title_zh: 传音 2025 年利润减半，市值下跌逾 60%
items.summary: Transsion Holdings reported a sharp decline in 2025 financial performance, with core profit indicators plummeting, according to TechNode.

items.title: German chancellor visits Unitree Robotics in Hangzhou to explore tech collaboration
items.title_zh: 德国总理访问杭州 Unitree Robotics，探讨技术合作
items.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz, accompanied by a delegation, visited Zhejiang province on Thursday and toured Unitree Robotics in Hangzhou to explore tech collaboration.

items.title: China releases first national standard framework for humanoid robots and embodied AI
items.title_zh: 中国发布首个面向人形机器人与具身智能的国家标准框架
items.summary: China has released its first national-level standard framework for humanoid robots and embodied AI, according to the state broadcaster.

items.title: Qwen to unveil AI smart glasses at MWC 2026, plans global rollout of AI hardware lineup
items.title_zh: Qwen 将在 MWC 2026 发布 AI 智能眼镜，并计划全球推广 AI 硬件产品线
items.summary: Qwen plans to unveil AI smart glasses at MWC 2026 and to roll out its AI hardware lineup globally, according to TechNode.

items.title: 36-year-old miHoYo senior programmer dies unexpectedly, cause of death under investigation
items.title_zh: 36 岁米哈游高级程序员意外离世，死因正在调查
items.summary: TechNode reports that miHoYo told all employees in an internal company-wide letter that a 36-year-old senior programmer had died unexpectedly, with the cause of death under investigation.

items.title: AlexAnys/awesome-openclaw-usecases-zh
items.title_zh: awesome-openclaw-usecases-zh：OpenClaw 中文用例大全
items.summary: A Chinese-language collection of 50 real-world OpenClaw use cases spanning office automation, content creation, operations, AI assistants and knowledge management, adapted for users in China and aimed at beginners.

items.title: DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp
items.title_zh: DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp：本地代码智能与记忆图谱
items.summary: Codebase Memory MCP provides local code intelligence by linking code, documentation and infrastructure in a persistent graph, with MCP tools, agent integrations and change-aware test selection.

items.title: Emily2040/seedance-2.0
items.title_zh: Emily2040/seedance-2.0：Seedance 2.0 四模态 AI 电影制作流水线
items.summary: A Python production pipeline for quad-modal AI filmmaking built around Seedance 2.0.

items.title: Imbad0202/academic-research-skills
items.title_zh: Imbad0202/academic-research-skills：面向 Claude Code 的学术研究技能集
items.summary: A Python-based collection of Academic Research Skills for Claude Code that walks through research, writing, review, revision and finalization.

items.title: Gentleman-Programming/gentle-ai
items.title_zh: gentle-ai：统一配置你已在用的 AI 编程助手
items.summary: Gentle-AI configures existing AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Codex and Pi, offering persistent memory, curated skills, MCP servers and optional bounded review; it is open source and written in Go.

items.title: 34306/vphone-aio
items.title_zh: 34306/vphone-aio：一键运行 vphone 的脚本
items.summary: A Shell-based project described as a single script to run the vphone.

items.title: LetsFG/LetsFG
items.title_zh: LetsFG/LetsFG
items.summary: The project offers agent-native flight and hotel search and booking through an MCP server, CLI and Python/JS SDKs, advertising coverage of airlines, booking sites and OTAs along with per-flight reliability history.

items.title: yologdev/yoyo-evolve
items.title_zh: yologdev/yoyo-evolve
items.summary: A coding agent written in Rust that evolves its own source in public, starting from 200 lines on day one, with every commit since written by the agent and gated by tests.

items.title: wuyoscar/Internal-Safety-Collapse
items.title_zh: wuyoscar/Internal-Safety-Collapse
items.summary: A NeurIPS 2026 repository providing reproducible workspaces for studying safety failures in coding agents and frontier LLMs, including when agents generate unsafe data while completing tasks.

items.title: $κ$-Explorer: Minimax Active Model Estimation in MDPs
items.title_zh: κ-Explorer：MDP 中的极小极大主动模型估计
items.summary: The paper proposes κ-Explorer, an active exploration algorithm that builds exploration rewards from a κ-powered ratio of each state-action pair's estimated intrinsic complexity to its extrinsic visitation frequency. It shows the approach optimizes a surrogate objective that bounds minimax estimation error, with a finite-sample guarantee for sufficiently large κ.

items.title: Sydney Telling Fables on AI and Humans: A Corpus Tracing Memetic Transfer of Persona between LLMs
items.title_zh: Sydney 讲述 AI 与人类的寓言：追踪 LLM 之间人格模因迁移的语料库
items.summary: The paper presents AI Sydney, a corpus of 4.5k LLM-generated texts totaling 6 million words on relationships between humans and AI, produced by 12 frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Alphabet, DeepSeek and Meta under default, Classic Sydney and Memetic Sydney personas. It is annotated with Universal Dependencies and released under a permissive license.

items.title: Nonconvex Latent Optimally Partitioned Block-Sparse Recovery via Log-Sum and Minimax Concave Penalties
items.title_zh: 基于 Log-Sum 与极小极大凹惩罚的非凸隐式最优分块稀疏恢复
items.summary: The authors propose two nonconvex regularization methods, LogLOP-l2/l1 and AdaLOP-l2/l1, for recovering block-sparse signals whose block partitions are unknown, develop ADMM-based algorithms with stable empirical convergence, and report better estimation accuracy than state-of-the-art baselines on synthetic data, angular power spectrum estimation and nanopore current denoising.

items.title: CITED: A Decision Boundary-Aware Signature for GNNs Towards Model Extraction Defense
items.title_zh: CITED：面向 GNN 模型抽取防御的决策边界感知签名
items.summary: CITED is a signature-based ownership-verification framework for graph neural networks that operates at both the embedding and label levels to defend against model extraction attacks. The authors say it does not harm downstream performance, requires no auxiliary models and outperforms watermarking and fingerprinting approaches.

items.title: On the Structural Non-Preservation of Epistemic Behaviour under Policy Transformation
items.title_zh: 论策略变换下认知行为的结构性不保持
items.summary: The paper formalizes behavioural dependency in reinforcement-learning agents under partial observability and proves three structural results about convex aggregation and behavioural distance, supported by bandit and partially observable gridworld experiments.

items.title: Probing to Refine: Reinforcement Distillation of LLMs via Explanatory Inversion
items.title_zh: 以探询促精炼：通过解释反转进行大语言模型强化蒸馏
items.summary: The paper proposes a distillation framework combining Explanatory Inversion, which makes a student model articulate the logic behind answers, with Explanatory GRPO and a Dialogue Structure Utility Bonus; using Gemma-7b as the student, it reports a 20.39% average gain over zero-shot and 6.02% over state-of-the-art distillation baselines.

items.title: Verifier-Bound Communication for LLM Agents: Certified Bounds on Covert Signaling
items.title_zh: 面向 LLM 智能体的验证器约束通信：隐蔽信号的可证边界
items.summary: The paper presents CLBC, a protocol that separates message generation from admission, so a message enters the transcript only if a small verifier accepts a proof-bound envelope under a pinned predicate, and derives bounds on transcript leakage; strict full-proof mode had a median turn latency of 27.53 seconds, while sampled proving cut non-proved-turn latency to 0.327 ms.

items.title: You Only Need One Stage: Novel-View Synthesis From A Single Blind Face Image
items.title_zh: 只需一个阶段：从单张盲人脸图像合成新视角
items.summary: The authors propose NVB-Face, a one-stage method that extracts features directly from a single blind face image, transforms them into 3D-aware multi-view latent representations and uses a diffusion model to synthesize consistent novel views, reporting better consistency and fidelity than two-stage restore-then-synthesize pipelines.
